 MISSOULA, Mont. — Two dressers sold on Amazon are being recalled because they pose tip-over and entrapment hazards that could seriously injure or kill children, according to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.
 The CPSC says both dressers can become unstable if they are not anchored to a wall. No injuries have been reported in either recall.
 The Soowery eight-drawer fabric dresser was sold on Amazon from December 2025 through August 2026 for about $106. Consumers should stop using the dresser if it is not anchored to a wall, keep children away from it and contact Soowery for a full refund.
 The Jocoevol six-drawer dresser was sold on Amazon from December 2024 through July 2026 for about $160. Consumers should stop using the dresser if it is not anchored to a wall, keep children away from it and contact Yinklev for a full refund.
 Consumers will be asked to mark the recalled dressers and submit photos to the companies before disposing of them.
 For refund instructions, contact Soowery at SOOWERYrecall@outlook.com or Jocoevol at Jocoevoldresserrecall@outlook.com.
